evals.prompt: I just bought an SO-101 arm. Walk me through installing LeRobot, calibrating the arm, recording a 50-episode dataset, and training an ACT policy on it.
evals.expected_output: Fetches https://huggingface.co/docs/lerobot/installation.md for install, https://huggingface.co/docs/lerobot/so101.md for calibration, https://huggingface.co/docs/lerobot/il_robots.md for the record+train flow, and https://huggingface.co/docs/lerobot/act.md for ACT-specific hyperparameters. Cites the HTML URLs back to the user.

evals.prompt: What changed in LeRobotDataset v3 vs v2, and how do I port an existing v2 dataset?
evals.expected_output: Applies the .md rewrite rule to fetch https://huggingface.co/docs/lerobot/lerobot-dataset-v3.md and https://huggingface.co/docs/lerobot/porting_datasets_v3.md, extracts the schema diff and migration CLI, cites both HTML URLs.

evals.prompt: I want to write my own policy class that plugs into LeRobot's training loop. What interface do I need to implement?
evals.expected_output: Fetches https://huggingface.co/docs/lerobot/bring_your_own_policies.md (primary) and optionally https://huggingface.co/docs/lerobot/action_representations.md for action-space config. Extracts the required class methods (forward, select_action, config keys) and the minimal example. Cites the HTML URL.
